trait.name: 飞掠
entries: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: 脑髓撕咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the death's head's next turn.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: Ankhtepot casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 19}):

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Ankhtepot dies, he revives with all his {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks somewhere in Har'Akir.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: If Ankhtepot fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: Ankhtepot has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Ankhtepot makes four Negative Energy Burst attacks. He can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast {@spell 律令震慑|XPHB}.

action.name: 负能量爆发
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 11}, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}26 ({@damage 6d6 + 5}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 往生咒{@recharge}
entries: Ankhtepot touches one creature within 5 feet. If the creature has 80 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or fewer, it dies. Otherwise, it takes 52 ({@damage 8d12}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: 致命一击
entries: Ankhtepot makes one Negative Energy Burst attack.

legendary.name: 命运之手
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 19}, one Large or smaller creature Ankhtepot can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Force damage, and the target is pushed or pulled up to 20 feet straight away or toward Ankhtepot. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

legendary.name: 时间之沙
entries: Ankhtepot teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. {@actSave 叉} {@dc 19}, each creature in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from Ankhtepot at his destination space. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage, and the target magically ages 10 years. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Ankhtepot can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: Azalin casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 20}):

spellcasting.name: 汲取法术
headerEntries: Azalin casts {@spell 法术反制|XPHB} in response to the spell's trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. If the target creature fails its saving throw against this {@spell 法术反制|XPHB}, Azalin steals knowledge of the triggering spell. For 1 hour or until Azalin takes this {@variantrule 反应|XPHB} again, Azalin can cast that spell once, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Azalin dies and his spirit jar remains intact, he revives with all his {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 2d10} days in the unoccupied space nearest his spirit jar. If Azalin's spirit jar is destroyed, he instead revives in {@dice 4d10} days in Castle Avernus in Darkon.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（4/天，或在领域中为5/天）
entries: If Azalin fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Azalin makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.

action.name: 魔能迸裂
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 12}，触及 5 尺或射程 120 尺。{@h}31（{@damage 4d12 + 5}）力场伤害。

action.name: 麻痹之触
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 12}, reach 5 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 3d6 + 5}) Cold damage, and the target has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until the start of Azalin's next turn.

legendary.name: 诡秘传送
entries: Azalin teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space he can see and makes one Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch attack.

legendary.name: 禁忌学识
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 20}, up to three creatures Azalin can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 震慑|XPHB} condition until the end of Azalin's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Azalin can't take this action again until the start of his next turn.

trait.name: 荚苗链接
entries: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it. When the plant dies, its podlings also die.

trait.name: 复生
entries: If the plant dies, it revives with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} days. This trait doesn't function if the plant is reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} by Poison damage or its remains are sprinkled with salt.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The plant makes three Vine attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Entrapping Pod.

action.name: 藤蔓
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 20 ft. {@h}17 ({@damage 3d8 + 4}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of four vines.

action.name: 诱捕荚
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, one Large or smaller creature the plant is grappling. {@actSaveFail} The target is pulled into the plant's space, is no longer {@condition 受擒|XPHB}, and is trapped in the plant's pod. While trapped, the target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} conditions, and it has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|全身掩护} against attacks and other effects outside the pod. After {@dice 2d4} hours, the trapped target dies, and if it was a Humanoid, a Bodytaker Podling resembling it emerges from the pod.

A creature outside the pod and within 5 feet of the plant can take an action to make a {@dc 14} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, the target is removed from the pod, falls in a space within 5 feet of the plant, and has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. If the plant dies, the trapped target is no longer {@condition 目盲|XPHB} or {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} and can escape from the pod using 5 feet of movement, exiting {@condition 倒地|XPHB}.

reaction.name: 转移重伤术
entries: {@actTrigger} An attack roll hits the plant while a podling is within 5 feet of the plant. {@actResponse} The plant halves the damage it takes from that attack, and the podling takes the other half of the damage.

monster.name: 夺躯者豆丁
languages: Deep Speech plus one other language

trait.name: 生命假象
entries: The podling is a physical copy of a creature digested by a Bodytaker Plant. The podling has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on Charisma ({@skill 欺瞒|XPHB}) checks made to pass as the digested creature. The podling melts into a slurry when it dies.

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: 劫持
entries: The boneless needn't spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.

trait.name: 柔韧躯体
entries: The boneless can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.

action.name: 卷紧
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 12}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} and {@condition 束缚|XPHB} conditions, is suffocating, and takes 7 ({@damage 2d4 + 2}) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the boneless's turns. The boneless can smother only one creature at a time. While grappling a target, the boneless can't take this action again.

bonus.name: 解离血肉（1/天）
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 11}, each creature within 30 feet that can see the boneless. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The boneless moves up to its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

monster.name: 缸中之脑
languages: telepathy 60 ft. understands Common plus three other languages but can't speak; telepathy 60 ft.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: The brain casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 14}):

trait.name: 侦测智能
entries: The brain magically senses the location of any creature within 300 feet of itself that has an Intelligence score of 3 or higher, regardless of interposing barriers.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: The brain has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The brain makes two Disrupting Burst attacks.

action.name: 干扰爆发
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 6}, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. {@h}11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Psychic damage. The target can't take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and it has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on saving throws to maintain {@status 专注|XPHB} until the end of its next turn.

action.name: 心灵震爆 {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave int} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 60-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition until the end of the brain's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The carrion stalker makes two Tentacle attacks and one Stinger attack.

action.name: 触须
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) Piercing damage, and the carrion stalker attaches to the target. While attached, the carrion stalker can't make Tentacle attacks against other targets.
The carrion stalker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the carrion stalker as an action.

action.name: 刺针
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5} (with {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} if the carrion stalker is attached to the target), reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 2d6}) Poison damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 13}. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB} in this way, the target is infested with a carrion stalker larva. If the target is still {@condition 中毒|XPHB} in this way after 24 hours, the effect ends as the larva becomes a fully grown Carrion Stalker, which bursts from the target's chest and kills it.

monster.name: 换身魔偶
languages: 通用语，外加另外一门语言

action.name: 银针
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 4}, reach 5 ft. {@h}1 Piercing damage plus 3 ({@damage 1d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a carrionette, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave 叉} {@dc 11}. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed for 1 minute. Until the curse ends, the target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition, and its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet.

action.name: 灵魂互换{@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave 叉} {@dc 11}, one Humanoid the carrionette can see within 15 feet that is cursed by its Silver Needle. {@actSaveFail} The carrionette possesses the target's body, and the target possesses the carrionette's body and has the {@condition 昏迷|XPHB} condition for 1 hour. While possessing another body, the carrionette and target retain their alignments; personalities; Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and languages known. They otherwise adopt the other creature's game statistics, though the target can't use this Soul Swap action.

The possession is undone if the target (while in the carrionette's body) deals damage to the carrionette (in the target's original body) with its Silver Needle. If either body is destroyed, both the carrionette and the target die.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Chakuna dies and her heart remains intact, she revives with all her {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks somewhere in Valachan. Chakuna's heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to all damage except Fire.

trait.name: 经验丰富的猎人
entries: {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB} composed of undergrowth doesn't cost Chakuna extra movement.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: If Chakuna fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Chakuna makes three attacks, using Scratch or Barbed Spear in any combination. She can replace one attack with a Bite attack.

action.name: 啃咬（仅限黑豹或混合形态）
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a Humanoid, it is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave con} {@dc 15}. {@actSaveFail} The target is cursed. If the cursed target drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it instead becomes a werepanther under the DM's control and has 10 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} (use the Weretiger stat block). {@actSaveSuccess} The target is immune to Chakuna's curse for 24 hours.

action.name: 抓挠
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d8 + 4}) Slashing damage.

action.ENG_name: Barbed Spear (Humanoid or Hybrid Form Only)
action.name: 倒刺矛（仅限类人或混种形态）
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Piercing damage and the target receives a dire wound if it doesn't have one. While the target is wounded, its speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it loses 5 ({@dice 1d10}) {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to staunch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a {@dc 15} Wisdom ({@skill 医药|XPHB}) check. {@hom}The spear magically returns to Chakuna's hand immediately after a ranged attack.

bonus.name: 潜步（仅限黑豹或混合形态）
entries: Chakuna moves up to her {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, she can take the Hide action.

bonus.name: 变形
entries: Chakuna shape-shifts into a Large panther-humanoid hybrid or a Large panther, or she returns to her true humanoid form. Her game statistics, other than her size, are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

legendary.name: 猛扑
entries: Chakuna moves up to half her {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} and makes one Scratch attack.

legendary.name: 幽影打击
entries: Chakuna makes one Barbed Spear attack. If Chakuna has the Hide action's {@condition 隐形|XPHB} condition, this attack doesn't end that condition. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

legendary.name: 突袭啃咬
entries: Chakuna uses Shape-Shift to turn into her hybrid form or panther form and then makes one Bite attack. Chakuna can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

monster.name: 克苏鲁
languages: 全部; 心灵感应 120 尺

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: Cthulhu casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 25}):

3e: {@spell 指使术|XPHB} (can target creatures through dreams)

trait.name: 水陆两栖
entries: Cthulhu can breathe air and water.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Cthulhu dies, it revives with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks inside the Vault of Cthulhu.

trait.name: 不可能几何
entries: Ground, air, and water in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from Cthulhu is {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. A creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Bludgeoning damage.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（4/天，或在领域中为5/天）
entries: If Cthulhu fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: Cthulhu has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Cthulhu makes three Eldritch Claw attacks and uses Spellcasting to cast {@spell 摧心术|XPHB} if available or {@spell 心灵尖刺|XPHB} (level 4 version). It can replace one Eldritch Claw attack with a use of Tentacle.

action.name: 诡秘爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 17}, reach 10 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 2d8 + 9}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 19}) from one of two limbs.

action.name: 触须
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 25}, one creature {@condition 受擒|XPHB} by Cthulhu. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Acid damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) Psychic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Psychic damage taken, and Cthulhu regains {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} equal to that amount.

bonus.name: 扭曲
entries: Cthulhu teleports to an unoccupied space it can see within 120 feet, taking creatures it is grappling with it. Then each creature within 10 feet of the space it left is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 25}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Thunder damage, and if the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

legendary.name: 夹钳
entries: Cthulhu makes an Eldritch Claw attack.

legendary.name: 空间折叠
entries: {@actSave 叉} {@dc 25}, each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule 球状 [效应区域]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point Cthulhu can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage, and the target is teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet of Cthulhu that is horizontal to it. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Cthulhu can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: 飞掠
entries: The death's head doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

action.name: 啃咬
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 3}, reach 5 ft. {@h}3 ({@damage 1d4 + 1}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage.

trait.name: 悬垂的树枝
entries: The tree's allies can willingly end their moves in the tree's space. Allies in the tree's space have {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|半身掩护}.

trait.name: 亵渎再生
entries: If the tree dies, {@dice 2d6} Death's Head Trees regrow around the same place in 365 days unless the tree is killed by a creature under the effect of a {@spell 祝福术|XPHB} spell using a weapon that deals Slashing damage.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The tree makes two Slam attacks.

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 6}, reach 10 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d10 + 4}) Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: 爆裂头部
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 14}, each creature in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule 球状 [效应区域]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point the tree can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage, and the creature has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of the tree's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: 头颅果实
entries: Each Undead ally in the tree's space can immediately take a {@variantrule 反应|XPHB} to gain 5 {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB}.

monster.name: 杜拉罕
languages: 理解通用语以及一门其他语言，但不会说

trait.name: 骑战大师
entries: While mounted and without the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition, the dullahan and its mount have {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on Dexterity saving throws, and the dullahan can force an attack targeted at its mount to target the dullahan instead.

trait.name: 恐怖使者
entries: The dullahan has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on attack rolls against targets that have the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The dullahan makes two attacks, using Beheading Blade or Fiery Skull in any combination, and uses Headless Wail.

action.name: 斩首之刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 8}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Necrotic damage. If the target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} by this attack, it dies and its head is lopped off. The head rises as a Death's Head in the space of the target's corpse or in the nearest unoccupied space. The head is under the dullahan's control. The dullahan can control no more than seven heads at a time.

action.name: 烈焰颅骨
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}18 ({@damage 4d8}) Fire damage.

action.name: 无头悲号
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, up to three creatures within 120 feet of the dullahan that aren't Constructs or Undead. {@actSaveFail} 13 ({@damage 2d12}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the start of the dullahan's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Ebonbane dies, it revives with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks, teleporting somewhere in Shadowborn Manor. Until it revives, Ebonbane acts as a +3 Longsword when wielded by a creature.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: If Ebonbane fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: Ebonbane has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Ebonbane makes three Darkflame Slash attacks. It can replace one of these attacks with a use of Possess {@variantrule 死亡|XPHB} if available.

action.name: 暗焰挥砍
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. or range 90 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 1d10 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 占据死尸 {@recharge 5}
entries: Ebonbane raises a Medium or Small Humanoid corpse within 5 feet of itself and possesses it. The corpse wields Ebonbane and is under its control. Ebonbane gains 50 {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB}, and its statistics are the same, except its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} increases to 30 feet, and it can speak through the corpse using any language the corpse knew in life.

The possession lasts until Ebonbane drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or Ebonbane ends the possession as a {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB}. Once the possession ends, Ebonbane can't possess the corpse again. The corpse crumbles to dust 24 hours after the possession ends.

action.name: 称职的持有者
entries: {@actSave 叉} {@dc 17}, one willing Humanoid within 5 feet. {@actSaveFail} 36 ({@damage 8d8}) Force damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, Ebonbane devourers its soul. A creature whose soul has been devoured by Ebonbane can be restored to life only by a {@spell 祈愿术|XPHB} spell. {@actSaveSuccess} The target attunes to Ebonbane and can wield the sword.

reaction.name: 格挡
entries: {@actTrigger} Ebonbane is hit by a melee attack roll. {@actResponse} Ebonbane adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary.name: 反击
entries: Ebonbane moves up to half its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} and makes one Darkflame Slash attack.

legendary.name: 符文耀斑
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, each creature of Ebonbane's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from Ebonbane. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 目盲|XPHB} condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. The target succeeds automatically after 1 minute. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} Ebonbane can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

monster.name: 古老者
languages: 深潜语; 心灵感应120尺

trait.name: 集群战术
entries: The gug has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the gug's allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn't have the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The gug makes two Claw attacks and uses Chew.

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}22 ({@damage 3d10 + 6}) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of two claws.

action.name: 咀嚼
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, up to two Medium or smaller creatures {@condition 受擒|XPHB} by the gug. {@actSaveFail} The gug places the target in its mouth and chews. A chewed creature is no longer {@condition 受擒|XPHB} but has the {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition. While {@condition 束缚|XPHB} in this way, a target has {@variantrule 掩护|XPHB|半身掩护} against attacks and other effects not originating from the gug and takes 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Piercing damage at the start of each of the gug's turns. A gug can have a maximum of four creatures in its mouth at a time.

A creature in the gug's mouth can take an action to make a {@dc 16} Strength ({@skill 运动|XPHB}) check. On a successful check, the target is no longer {@condition 束缚|XPHB} and moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the gug. If the gug dies, a target is no longer {@condition 束缚|XPHB} and can escape from the gug using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition.

legendary.name: 突袭啃咬

entries: Sticky ectoplasm slows creatures in a 15-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the priest. {@actSave str} {@dc 15}, each creature that starts its turn in the {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环}. {@actSaveFail} The target's {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: 3: 吸血恩赐
entries: When the priest deals Necrotic damage to a creature, the priest gains {@variantrule 临时生命值|XPHB} equal to the damage dealt.

trait.name: 4：爆燃恩惠
entries: The priest has a {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB} of 30 feet and {@variantrule 免疫|XPHB} to Fire damage.

trait.name: 5: 灵体化恩赐
entries: The priest has {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and it has {@variantrule 易伤|XPHB} to Radiant damage. Additionally, the priest can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. It takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

trait.name: 6：致命恩惠
entries: When the priest revives with this boon, all corpses of Small or Medium Humanoids in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the priest rise as Skeletons under the priest's control. Additionally, at the end of each of the priest's turns, each non-Undead creature in a 5-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the priest takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Necrotic damage.

The priest dies and this trait doesn't function if the priest receives a boon it already has or the priest's tattoo of Osybus is destroyed. The tattoo is destroyed only if the priest takes 15 damage or more on a single turn while the priest has 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The priest makes two attacks, using Soul Blade or Necrotic Bolt in any combination.

action.name: 魂刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until the start of the priest's next turn. If this damage reduces a Medium or smaller creature to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, the creature dies, and its soul becomes trapped in a soul tattoo on the priest's body. The soul is freed if the priest dies.

action.name: 暗蚀箭
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 7}, range 120 ft. {@h}30 ({@damage 4d12 + 4}) Necrotic damage, and the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} until the start of the priest's next turn.

bonus.name: 灵魂刺青{@recharge 5}
entries: The priest magically animates a soul tattoo on its body that becomes a Shadow in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the priest. The shadow takes its turn immediately after the priest on the same {@variantrule 先攻|XPHB} count, and it obeys the priest. The shadow remains animate until it is destroyed, it is more than 120 feet from the priest, the priest dies, or the priest uses this {@variantrule 附赠动作|XPHB} again.

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: Ramya casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 17}):

spellcasting.name: 幻象伪装
headerEntries: Ramya casts {@spell 易容术|XPHB} using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The spell lasts until Ramya drops to 80 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} or fewer or uses her Vengeful Fire action. Intelligence ({@skill 调查|XPHB}) checks to discern her true appearance are made with {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB}.

When the disguise ends, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from Ramya is subjected to the following effect. Wisdom {@variantrule 豁免检定|XPHB}: {@dc 17} (the target succeeds automatically if it is a Construct or an Undead). Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. While Frightened, the target has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on saving throws.

spellcasting.name: 恐怖权威
headerEntries: Ramya casts {@spell 命令术|XPHB}, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. Ramya can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Ramya dies, her body dissolves into mist, and she gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} weeks, reviving with all her {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} somewhere in Kalakeri.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: If Ramya fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 魔法抗性
entries: Ramya has {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

trait.name: 不死统帅
entries: Undead creatures of Ramya's choice (excluding herself) in a 60-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from her have {@variantrule 优势|XPHB} on attack rolls and saving throws. She can't use this trait if she has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Ramya makes three Dread Blade attacks.

action.name: 恐怖之刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 5 ft. {@h}12 ({@damage 2d6 + 5}) Slashing damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 复仇之火 {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 17}, each creature in a 20-foot-radius {@variantrule 球状 [效应区域]|XPHB|球状} centered on a point Ramya can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Fire damage plus 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

reaction.name: 格挡
entries: {@actTrigger} Ramya is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. {@actResponse} Ramya adds 5 to her AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.

legendary.name: 猛冲
entries: Ramya moves up to half her {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} and makes one Dread Blade attack.

legendary.name: 静默箴言
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature Ramya can see within 120 feet. {@actSaveFail} 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed until the end of its next turn. Until the curse ends, the target can't speak or cast spells with a Verbal component. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

hp.special: 5 plus five times your Artificer level (the companion has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Artificer level)

trait.name: 自爆
entries: The companion explodes when it dies. {@actSave dex} DC equals your spell save DC, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the companion. {@actSaveFail} {@damage 2d4} Necrotic damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage.

trait.name: 闪电吸收
entries: Whenever the companion is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.

action.name: 恐怖挥击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hitYourSpellAttack 加值等于你的法术攻击加值}, reach 5 ft. {@h}{@dice 1d4} plus your Intelligence modifier Necrotic damage, and the target can't take Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

monster.name: 无情主宰
languages: 理解所有语言但不会说

trait.name: 传奇抗性 (3/日)
entries: 若主宰豁免失败，其可以改为选择豁免成功。

trait.name: 再生
entries: The juggernaut regains 10 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} at the start of each of its turns. If the juggernaut takes Radiant damage or damage from a {@variantrule 重击|XPHB}, this trait doesn't function on the juggernaut's next turn. The juggernaut dies only if it starts its turn with 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} and doesn't regenerate.

trait.name: 攻城怪物
entries: 岩石战车对物件和建筑造成双倍伤害。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The juggernaut makes two attacks, using Executioner's Blade or Crushing Stone in any combination.

action.name: 处刑者之刃
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 10 ft. {@h}19 ({@damage 3d8 + 6}) Slashing damage, and the target's {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the juggernaut's next turn.

action.name: 碾压岩石
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 10}, range 60 ft. {@h}13 ({@damage 2d6 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition until the start of the juggernaut's next turn.

legendary.name: 所向无前
entries: The juggernaut moves up to half its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, ignoring {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. Each creature in its path is subjected to the following effect. {@actSave str} {@dc 18}. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} The juggernaut can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

legendary.name: 横扫之刃
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 18}, each creature in a 15-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 1d10 + 6}) Slashing damage, and the target is pulled up to 10 feet straight toward the juggernaut.

monster.name: 坚韧梦魇
languages: 理解所有语言但不会说

trait.name: 传奇抗性（2/日）
entries: If the nightmare fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 梦魇复苏
entries: If the nightmare dies, its body disappears into mist, and it gains a new body in {@dice 1d10} days, reviving with all its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in the nearest unoccupied space next to an {@condition 昏迷|XPHB} creature cursed by its Haunter's Spear. This trait doesn't function if there are no remaining targets cursed in this way.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The nightmare makes two Haunter's Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Exhausting Gaze.

action.name: 猎魂者之矛
entries: {@atk m,r} +9, reach 10 ft. or range 60 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d8 + 5}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Psychic damage. Additionally, the target is cursed by the nightmare if it isn't already. Until this curse ends, finishing a {@variantrule 长休|XPHB} doesn't reduce the target's {@condition 力竭|XPHB} level.

action.name: 疲惫凝视
entries: {@actSave wis} {@dc 16}, one creature the nightmare can see within 60 feet. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Psychic damage, and the target gains 1 {@condition 力竭|XPHB} level.

legendary.name: 梦游
entries: The nightmare teleports to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of a creature it can see, then makes a Haunter's Spear attack.

legendary.name: 麻醉
entries: The nightmare targets one creature it can see within 120 feet that's cursed by its Haunter's Spear. The target takes 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Psychic damage and has the {@condition 昏迷|XPHB} condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.

languages: 理解所有语言但不会说

trait.name: 传奇抗性（1/日）
entries: 若劈砍者豁免失败，它可以改为选择豁免成功。

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 撕裂者进行两次撕裂者小刀攻击。

action.name: 撕裂者之刃
entries: {@atkr m,r} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30/60 ft. {@h}9 ({@damage 2d4 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 21 ({@damage 6d6}) Necrotic damage.

legendary.name: 追踪刀
entries: {@actSave dex} {@dc 15}, one creature within 120 feet that the slasher has hit with its Slasher's Knife attack within the last 24 hours. {@actSaveFail} 11 ({@damage 2d6 + 4}) Slashing damage.

legendary.name: 消失打击
entries: The slasher makes one Slasher's Knife attack, then teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. The slasher can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

trait.name: 伊拉斯谟之盾

action.name: 多重攻击

action.name: 银剑手杖
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Slashing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Radiant damage. Critical {@h}The target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until it finishes a {@variantrule 长休|XPHB}. It makes a {@dc 15} Constitution saving throw at end of each hour, ending the effect on a success.

action.name: 手弩
entries: {@atkr r} {@hit 5}, range 30/120 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d6 + 2}) Piercing damage plus 5 ({@damage 2d4}) Radiant damage.

action.name: 驱散邪恶 {@recharge 5}
entries: {@actSave 叉} {@dc 15}, each creature of Rudolph's choice in a 30-foot {@variantrule 锥状 [效应区域]|XPHB|锥状}. {@actSaveFail} 18 ({@damage 4d8}) Psychic damage, and the target has the {@condition 恐慌|XPHB} condition until the end of Rudolph's next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

bonus.name: 神秘援助（2/天）
entries: Rudolph casts {@spell 疗伤术|XPHB}, {@spell 驱逐善恶|XPHB}, or {@spell 庇护术|XPHB}, using Wisdom as the spellcasting modifier (spell save {@dc 15}).

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: Saidra casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save {@dc 15}):

spellcasting.name: 真理或死亡（1/天）
headerEntries: Saidra asks a creature she can see within 60 feet to identify itself and casts {@spell 解离术|XPHB} targeting the creature, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability ({@dc 15}, with {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} if the target lies).

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Saidra dies, she revives with all her {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks somewhere in Dementlieu.

trait.name: 虚体移动
entries: Saidra can move through other creatures and objects as if they were {@variantrule 困难地形|XPHB}. She takes 5 ({@damage 1d10}) Force damage if she ends her turn inside an object.

trait.name: 测谎仪
entries: Saidra knows whether she hears a lie.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: If Saidra fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.

trait.name: 日照敏感
entries: While in sunlight, Saidra has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on ability checks and attack rolls

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Saidra makes three Necrotic Burst attacks. She can replace one of these attacks with a use of Spellcasting.

action.name: 暗能爆裂
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 7}, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. {@h}14 ({@damage 2d10 + 3}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 吸取生命
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 15}, one creature Saidra can see within 30 feet. {@actSaveFail} 28 ({@damage 8d6}) Necrotic damage, and its {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

action.name: 随意：
entries: {@spell 魅惑类人|XPHB} (duchess form only), {@spell 恐惧术|XPHB} (Red Death form only).

bonus.name: 变形
entries: Saidra shape-shifts into the Red Death, or she returns to her true form as the duchess. Her game statistics are the same in each form. Any equipment she is wearing or carrying isn't transformed.

legendary.name: 鞭笞
entries: Saidra makes one Necrotic Burst attack.

legendary.name: 暗影面纱
entries: Saidra gives herself the {@condition 隐形|XPHB} condition until the start of her next turn and can fly up to half her {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB}. The condition ends early immediately after Saidra deals damage. Saidra can't take this action again until the start of her next turn.

trait.name: 水陆两栖
entries: 修格斯可以在空气和水中呼吸。

trait.name: 拟声
entries: The shoggoth can mimic voices and animal sounds. A creature that hears this mimicry can tell it is an imitation only with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom ({@skill 洞悉|XPHB}) check.

trait.name: 易受魅惑
entries: The shoggoth has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on saving throws to avoid or end the {@condition 魅惑|XPHB} condition.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The shoggoth makes three Pseudopod attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Suction Burst if available.

action.name: 伪足
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 10}, reach 15 ft. {@h}15 ({@damage 2d8 + 6}) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 ({@damage 2d10}) Thunder damage, and the creature has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 16}) from one of four pseudopods.

action.name: 吸力爆发 {@recharge 4}
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 18}, one creature {@condition 受擒|XPHB} by the shoggoth. {@actSaveFail} 22 ({@damage 4d10}) Thunder damage, and the target is repelled from the shoggoth. The target no longer has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition, is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the shoggoth, and has the {@condition 耳聋|XPHB} and {@condition 震慑|XPHB} conditions until the end of its next turn. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage only.

reaction.name: 寒冷冲刺
entries: {@actTrigger} The shoggoth is subjected to Cold damage. {@actResponse} The shoggoth moves up to its {@variantrule 速度|XPHB} and can make one Pseudopod attack with {@variantrule 优势|XPHB}.

trait.name: 不死坚韧
entries: If damage reduces the skeleton to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it makes a Constitution saving throw ({@dc 5} plus the damage taken) unless the damage is Radiant or from a {@variantrule 重击|XPHB}. On a successful save, the skeleton drops to 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} instead.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The skeleton makes two Vampiric Longsword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.

action.name: 吸血长剑
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d8 + 3}) Slashing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken.

action.name: 盾击
entries: {@actSave str} {@dc 13}, one creature within 5 feet that the skeleton can see. {@actSaveFail} 10 ({@damage 2d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 倒地|XPHB} condition

spellcasting.name: 施法
headerEntries: 施特拉德施放以下任意一个法术，使用智力作为施法能力（法术豁免{@dc 18}）:

spellcasting.name: 魅惑
headerEntries: Strahd casts {@spell 魅惑类人|XPHB}, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. When the spell is cast this way, its duration is 24 hours, and the Charmed target is a willing recipient of Strahd's Bite, the damage of which doesn't end the spell. When the spell ends, the target is unaware it was Charmed by Strahd.

spellcasting.name: 伯爵之令
headerEntries: Strahd casts {@spell 命令术|XPHB} (level 2 version), requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.

trait.name: 黑暗领主复原
entries: If Strahd dies, he revives with all his {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in {@dice 1d10} weeks somewhere in Barovia.

trait.name: 传奇抗性（3次/天，或在领域内4次/天）
entries: 如果施特拉德在一次豁免骰失败，他可以选择改为使其成功。

trait.name: 雾隐遁行
entries: If Strahd drops to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} outside his resting place, he uses Shape-Shift to become mist (no action required). If he can't use Shape-Shift, he is destroyed. While Strahd has 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} in mist form, he can't return to his vampire form, and he must reach his resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his resting place, Strahd returns to his vampire form and has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until he regains any {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, and he regains 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} after spending 1 hour there.

trait.name: 蛛行术
entries: Strahd can climb difficult surfaces, including ceilings, without making an ability check.

trait.name: 吸血鬼弱点
entries: Strahd has these weaknesses:

items.name: 禁制术
entries: Strahd can't enter a residence without an invitation from an occupant.

items.name: 流水
entries: Strahd takes 20 Acid damage if he ends his turn in running water.

items.name: 桩刺
entries: If a weapon that deals Piercing damage is driven into Strahd's heart while Strahd has the {@condition 失能|XPHB} condition in his resting place, Strahd has the {@condition 麻痹|XPHB} condition until the weapon is removed.

items.name: 阳光
entries: Strahd takes 20 Radiant damage if he starts his turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, he has {@variantrule 劣势|XPHB} on attack rolls and ability checks.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: Strahd makes two Death Strike attacks. He can replace one of these attacks with a use of (A) Bite or (B) Spellcasting to cast {@spell 火球术|XPHB} if available.

action.name: 致命一击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 9}, reach 5 ft. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) Slashing damage plus 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Necrotic damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB} condition (escape {@dc 14}) from one of two hands.

action.name: 啃咬（蝙蝠或吸血鬼形态）
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 17}, one creature within 5 feet that is willing or that has the {@condition 受擒|XPHB}, {@condition 失能|XPHB}, or {@condition 束缚|XPHB} condition. {@actSaveFail} 7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) Piercing damage plus 10 ({@damage 3d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} equal to that amount. A Humanoid reduced to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} by this damage rises the following night as a Vampire Spawn under Strahd's control, unless the Humanoid is restored to life or its body is destroyed.

bonus.name: 变形
entries: If Strahd isn't in sunlight or running water, he shape-shifts into a Tiny bat ({@variantrule 速度|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB} 30 ft.), a Medium wolf ({@variantrule 速度|XPHB} 40 ft.), or a Medium cloud of mist ({@variantrule 速度|XPHB} 5 ft., {@variantrule 飞行速度|XPHB} 20 ft. [hover]), or he returns to his vampire form. Anything he is wearing transforms with him.
While in bat or wolf form, Strahd can't speak. His game statistics, other than his size and {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, are unchanged.

While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless and can enter an enemy's space and stop there. If air can pass through a space, Strahd can do so, but he can't pass through liquid. Strahd has {@variantrule 抗性|XPHB} to all damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

legendary.name: 阔步打击
entries: Strahd moves up to half his {@variantrule 速度|XPHB}, and he makes one Death Strike attack.

trait.name: 蚊蝠感应
entries: The strigoi can magically control stirges within 120 feet of itself using a special telepathy.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: The strigoi makes two Claw attacks and one Proboscis attack.

action.name: 爪击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}，触及 5 尺。{@h}10（{@damage 2d6 + 3}）挥砍伤害。

action.name: 刺喙
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}5 ({@damage 1d4 + 3}) Piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) Necrotic damage. The target's {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值} maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage taken, and the strigoi regains {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB} equal to that amount. trait.name: 不死坚韧
entries: 若伤害使丧尸的生命值降至 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}，除非该伤害为光耀伤害或来自{@variantrule 重击|XPHB}，否则丧尸进行一次体质豁免（{@dc 5}加上所受伤害）。豁免成功则改为将生命值降至 1 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB|生命值}。

trait.name: 病毒灵光
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the zombie. {@actSaveFail} The target has the {@condition 中毒|XPHB} condition until the start of its next turn. While {@condition 中毒|XPHB}, the target can't regain {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}. {@actSaveSuccess} The creature is immune to this zombie's Viral Aura for 24 hours.

action.name: 多重攻击
entries: 丧尸发动两次猛击攻击。

action.name: 猛击
entries: {@atkr m} {@hit 5}, reach 5 ft. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 ({@damage 2d8}) Necrotic damage.

action.name: 毒性瘴气（1/日）
entries: {@actSave con} {@dc 12}, each creature in a 30-foot {@variantrule 光环 [效应区域]|XPHB|光环} originating from the zombie. {@actSaveFail} 14 ({@damage 4d6}) Poison damage. {@actSaveSuccess} Half damage. {@actSaveSuccessOrFail} If this damage reduces the target to 0 {@variantrule 生命值|XPHB}, it dies and rises 1 minute later as a Zombie.
